summary: Added sdk/scheduler (daily.py, __init__.py) with DailyScheduler, SchedulerConfig (max_actions, period, stop_file), SkippedRequest and ScheduleReport. run() takes one alias-checked snapshot, plans with the given policy, and executes the requests in order through ActionRunner, which re-snapshots for every action. It is dry-run unless execute=True. It checks the stop file before every action, enforces the action budget, skips once-per-period actions whose journal shows a verified or uncertain attempt within the period, and stops on the first contradicted outcome, on an unknown outcome for a non-idempotent action, and on UncertainPriorAttemptError or AccountMismatchError. Added 10 fake-game tests and docs/baseline/daily-scheduler.md. Not wired into run.py.

contract_status_changes.before: Policy plans could not be executed; only single actions could run
contract_status_changes.after: A dry-run-by-default scheduler executes policy plans with budgets, cooldowns, an operator stop and fail-safe stops

residual_risks: The plan is made once per run from the first snapshot; later actions are checked against fresh state but are not re-planned.

Once-per-period detection depends on journal history; a reward collected outside Tachikoma (for example manually) is not seen and the scheduler will attempt it, which the runner reconciles as not-observed.
